intro.text: Lawns R Us is a licensed and insured landscape and lawn service led by a father and son team and their crew, with more than 35 years in business. Based in Stony Brook and serving all of Suffolk County, they handle lawn care and maintenance, spring and fall cleanups, pruning, mulching and more, for homes and businesses. Estimates are free.
intro.quote: Making Suffolk beautiful, one lawn at a time.

items.d: Ongoing care that keeps your lawn and property looking sharp through the season.
Get the yard ready in spring and put it to bed in fall.
Neat, healthy cuts for shrubs and plantings.
Fresh mulch in your beds to finish the look.
